name: How long does a small kitchen renovation usually take?

mainEntity.name: How long does a small kitchen renovation usually take?

acceptedAnswer.text: A typical small kitchen remodel takes between three to six weeks of active construction, depending on project complexity. The timeline starts with demolition, followed by rough-in work for electrical outlets, lighting, and plumbing. Drywall repairs and prep come next, after which cabinets and countertops are installed. Custom stone counters often require templating after base cabinets are secured, introducing a brief lead time before final sink plumbing, backsplashes, and trim work wrap up. Unforeseen structural issues or custom material orders can lengthen the schedule.
acceptedAnswer.description: Most small kitchen renovations take 3 to 6 weeks. The timeline varies based on rough-in work, drywall patching, and fabrication lead times for countertops.
